name: Alex Example
headline: Operations Coordinator
summary: Operations coordinator with eight years in logistics and customer service. Runs daily planning for a team of twelve and keeps suppliers, customers and warehouse aligned.

experience.title: Operations Coordinator
bullets: Plan daily deliveries for a team of 12 drivers across Vaud and Geneva.
Cut late deliveries from 9% to 3% by reorganising the morning dispatch.
Handle escalations from key customers in French and English.

experience.title: Customer Service Agent
bullets: Answered about 60 customer requests a day by phone, e-mail and chat.
Trained 5 new team members on the order system.
